import re,subprocess
t=subprocess.run(['git','show','eb7838b16490ca7ba17ea3242ade76a61f744af2:SKILL.md'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines()
fence=False; inl=False
bullets=[]; cited=[]
cite=re.compile(r'(?:\.md|\.sh|\.mjs|\.py|\.json|README|PROVINCE|SCORECARD|PROTOCOL|corpus/|plans/|tools/|\.ufo/|\(round\s*\d|\(I\)|\(measured)')
for i,l in enumerate(t,1):
    if l.startswith('```'):
        fence=not fence; continue
    if fence: continue
    if l.startswith('## '): inl=True; continue
    if inl and re.match(r'^[-*] ',l):
        bullets.append(i)
        if cite.search(l): cited.append(i)
unc=[b for b in bullets if b not in set(cited)]
print('bullets_outside_fences',len(bullets),'with_source_token',len(cited),'without',len(unc))
print('uncited_lines',unc[:40])
